newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea prices up at weekly auction.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea prices up at weekly auction.

text.p: Bangladeshi tea prices rose at the weekly auction on Tuesday with strong participation by foreign and local buyers, brokers said.
Pakistan dominated the market for Medium Small Brokens and Fannings while Poland, Russia and others lent strong support.
Home buyers operated strongly for good liquoring types and dusts, which sold at higher rates.

The average price was 61.91 taka per kg, up 3.11 taka from the previous sale. Some 1.06 million kg were sold. The next sale will be held on July 15 with an expected offer of 1.03 million kg. ($ 1=43.65 taka)
